question: What will RWA.xyz report as total Distributed Asset Value (excluding stablecoins) on 31 December 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Below $40B": Wins if the total Distributed Asset Value (excluding stablecoins) reported on the RWA.xyz main dashboard (app.rwa.xyz) as of 31 December 2026 is below $40,000,000,000.
- "$40B – $40.5B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $40,000,000,000 and below $40,500,000,000.
- "$40.5B – $41B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $40,500,000,000 and below $41,000,000,000.
- "$41B – $41.5B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $41,000,000,000 and below $41,500,000,000.
- "$41.5B – $42B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $41,500,000,000 and below $42,000,000,000.
- "$42B – $42.5B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $42,000,000,000 and below $42,500,000,000.
- "$42.5B – $43B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $42,500,000,000 and below $43,000,000,000.
- "$43B – $43.5B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $43,000,000,000 and below $43,500,000,000.
- "$43.5B – $44B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $43,500,000,000 and below $44,000,000,000.
- "$44B – $44.5B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $44,000,000,000 and below $44,500,000,000.
- "$44.5B – $45B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $44,500,000,000 and below $45,000,000,000.
- "$45B – $45.5B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $45,000,000,000 and below $45,500,000,000.
- "$45.5B – $46B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $45,500,000,000 and below $46,000,000,000.
- "$46B – $46.5B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $46,000,000,000 and below $46,500,000,000.
- "$46.5B – $47B": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $46,500,000,000 and below $47,000,000,000.
- "$47B or above": Wins if the value is greater than or equal to $47,000,000,000.

Clarifications:
- The measured quantity is the "Distributed Asset Value" figure displayed on the RWA.xyz main dashboard (app.rwa.xyz) with the stablecoins toggle disabled (excluding stablecoins and cash equivalents), read at 23:59 UTC on 31 December 2026. If RWA.xyz publishes a dated historical snapshot for 31 December 2026, that snapshot takes precedence over any live reading taken after that date.
